description: Machine-readable index of every example. dir is the directory under examples/; standard is the estate format or package it teaches; runs is 'standalone' when the example runs and tests with nothing installed, 'needs-packages' when it imports one or more of the estate's npm packages; packages lists exactly the bare-specifier packages its index.mjs and index.test.mjs import (empty for standalone). standalone is the same fact as a boolean, kept for readers of the first revision of this manifest.
